title: WRSI water requirement satisfaction index (FEWS NET)
description: Cropland and rangeland water requirement satisfaction index from USGS/FEWS NET, for the KE-ENSO agriculture layer.

transfer.rationale: Re-run the ingest against its public origin rather than copying; the ingest is the definition of the dataset.

gaps: Only the cropland-MAM series extends to 2026; other series stop earlier.

changelog.change: Record created; back-filled from the existing CDH record and ingest script.
